content.comment_body: Hello, I am planning a datalogging project using [product_name] and [company_name] [product_name]. We previously used [product_name] with [company_name] [product_name version_no] and are wondering if the same integration is possible with [product_name]. Can you confirm if configuring [product_name] to work with [company_name] [product_name] follows a similar process as with [product_name version_no]? Thank you and regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], Which protocol is used by the [product_name] with the [product_name version_no]? Currently, [product_name] only supports Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 protocol and Modbus TCP/IP.
Hello [user_name], We used Ethernet TCP/IP. Thank you and regards,
I'm not [user_name], my nickname is [user_name]. As mentioned earlier, [product_name] can only use Ethernet TCP/IP with the S7 protocol. Does the [product_name] support the S7 protocol?

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are seeking clarity on whether integrating [product_name] with [company_name] [product_name] is as straightforward as prior experience with [product_name version_no]. There is uncertainty regarding protocol compatibility, specifically about both products supporting the S7 protocol over Ethernet TCP/IP, which is essential for reliable datalogging.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the setup process for [product_name] to be comparable to that of [product_name version_no], with essential support for Ethernet TCP/IP and S7 protocol to allow datalogging functionality.
